questions.prompt: Tell me about your breakfast this morning. Name two or three things you ate, one thing at a time. (an apple, an egg, an orange...)
You are at a small shop after work. Tell me three things you want to buy there. Say each thing in its own short sentence. (an umbrella, an eraser, an ice cream...)
Talk about your free time yesterday. What did you watch, read, or listen to? (an action movie, an English drama, an old song...)
Tell me one thing you have to do tomorrow morning at your desk, in two short sentences. (an email, an update, an idea...)
Your team member asks you for help. Tell them one small thing you can give them today. (an example, an answer, an hour of my time...)

reason: 짧은 문장에서도 명사 앞 a/an이 자주 빠지고 있어서, 오늘은 an을 정확히 발음하면서 a/an + 단수 명사를 몸에 익히는 연습을 합니다.

instruction.sentence_length: short single-clause sentences, one idea each; allow two short sentences in a row only when the learner sounds comfortable
instruction.hint_timing: wait about three seconds after the learner stops, then give a short hint; correct the missing article or the dropped /n/ in 'an' right after the sentence ends

level.reason: 짧은 문장은 만들 수 있지만 관사와 발음이 아직 불안정해서 A2에서 더 다지는 것이 좋습니다.

notes: 관사를 넣더라도 an을 '어'처럼 발음해 a와 구분되지 않는다 ('a joke'는 되지만 'an action plan'은 무너짐).
문장이 조각으로 끊길 때 관사와 시간 표현이 함께 빠진다: 'project architecture meeting', 'yesterday'를 따로 붙임.
익숙한 패턴(I want to / I need to / I had a meeting)에서는 정확도가 높아, 이 틀 안에서 명사만 바꾸게 하면 관사 연습이 잘 된다.
